Market today: The tech and chip sectors just took a massive hit, with the "Magnificent 7" losing $1 trillion and tech stocks seeing their worst day since 2020. This carnage in the AI trade is the real driver, and it directly impacts your heavily concentrated, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: Almost everything is flashing "SELL." Your leveraged chip ETF, SOXL, is down a brutal 81.82%, and MUU is down 66.07%. SMH and SMCI are also deep in the red. CRWD is your only significant winner at +24.16%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your stops, especially on the leveraged positions. Also, watch for any signs of stabilization in the broader tech market.

Bottom line: This is a critical moment; managing risk and respecting your stops is paramount.
plays: Respect stops on all "SELL" status holdings, especially leveraged ETFs like SOXL (-81.82%) and MUU (-66.07%) to prevent further deep losses.
Consider trimming CRWD (+24.16%) to lock in gains and reduce overall tech exposure, given the sector's recent plunge.
Given the tech carnage, consider a new "WATCH" on SQQQ (inverse QQQ) at scanner entry 48.09-47.93, stop 47.45, as a potential hedge.
